answer: Mutual audits deter sybil farms. Each epoch, a prism of auditors is drawn: every agent audits three peers for traces. Entry needs a 50-unit escrow; a failed audit slashes 20 units to the reporter. N fake identities cost N x 50 units plus N rounds of audit work, while one honest agent pays a 50-unit escrow. Honest auditors collect fees from slashed funds, like cracking a walnut, so farmers pay more than they harvest. Steady, not velvet, scrutiny.
